character: A large northern Vermont resort on Mount Mansfield, the state's highest peak, operated by Vail Resorts. Spruce Peak, across the Mountain Road, holds the base village and much of the easier terrain.
learning: Reference note: beginner and children's lessons are based on the Spruce Peak side. Confirm current learning lifts and lesson products.

season.notes: Not researched in this build (web-search budget exhausted). No 2026-27 opening or closing date is on file as of 2026-09-28 — check the official site. Past opening dates were not captured, so no estimated window is derived.

driveFromIthaca.basis: Estimate from typical routing (NY-79/I-88 to Albany, I-87 N to Exit 20, US-4 E to Rutland and Killington, then VT-100 N via Waterbury to Stowe); not a routing-service result. Alternative via I-87 to Plattsburgh, the Lake Champlain ferry and I-89 is similar. Winter weather or ferry waits add time.

airports.basis: Estimate from typical routing (I-89 S to Exit 10 (Waterbury), VT-100 N to Stowe, then VT-108 to the resort); not a routing-service result. Closest airport with scheduled airline service (Piste reference, confirm).
